**Problem:** The review count is wrong. The approved claim is "over 1,200 reviews". "Over 2,000" overstates it and can't be published without a source showing the count has grown. Either revert to 1,200 or supply the current figure with a source.

**Slop and structure check:** No ban-list words, no exclamation marks, no rhetorical opener, no em-dashes. The opening "Rainy Sunday, second pot." is concrete and fine for an own-account Instagram post.

**Disclosure:** Own brand account, no affiliate or gifted product, so nothing to label.

**Suggested fix:**
> Rainy Sunday, second pot. Our Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website.

Hold the post until the number is corrected.
